messages:
Maya Chen: Quick check — release cutoff in ~48h and the quickstart sample app CI started failing after the example-deps bump. Can someone confirm who owns the sampleapp fix vs docs changelog?

Samir Patel: I saw the CI flake this morning. Looks like the example repo bumped @example/lib from 2.3.1 -> 3.0.0 and it changed the init API.

Riley Gomez: Repro locally: failing on `ExampleClient()` constructor args. Error: "missing config key 'region'". Stack points at sampleapp/src/init.js line 12.

Jin Park: Tagging infra: we can roll the sampleapp back to 2.3.1 for the tag build if owners ask. Quick revert command: `git checkout tags/v1.2.0 -- sampleapp/package.json && yarn install`

Maya Chen: Who on devexp owns the sample app repo right now? I remember @Riley was point but wanted to confirm. Also need docs changelog entry (breaking change note) — that falls to docs owners if we accept bump.

Riley Gomez: I can own the repo fix (small code change to adapt to 3.0.0). But I need a +1 to ship a patch that targets the quickstart branch today.

Samir Patel: +1 to Riley shipping the adapter patch. We should also add a test to CI that pins the example-deps minor to catch major bumps. Suggestion: add a matrix job with `example-lib@~2.3.0` pinned and another `example-lib@latest` to surface breakages early.

Maya Chen: Nice. Docs question: do we want to call out the change as a breaking upgrade or hide it and keep quickstart on pinned dep? My vote: call it out in the changelog under 'Quickstarts' so users see potential friction.

Jin Park: Agreed. If Riley ships adapter and we unpin later, file a docs PR referencing the changelog section and sampleapp commit SHA. I can help with the release tag and CI patch to pin the build until we verify.

Riley Gomez: Plan: I'll open PR for adapter -> target: quickstarts/patch branch. Will include test and update package.json to tolerate both APIs (small shim). ETA: 6h.

Maya Chen: Perfect. Action items: 1) Riley — PR + tests (ETA 6h). 2) Jin — temporary CI pin on release build until PR merges. 3) Samir — add CI matrix suggestion as a follow-up PR (low priority). 4) Docs-bot — please remind docs owners to add changelog note after Riley's PR merges.

docs-bot: Reminder queued: when PR riley/adapter merges, request docs entry in the next changelog slice. :bell:

Samir Patel: One more ask — Riley, can you include a short code snippet in the sample README showing the new init signature? That will make the docs PR easier.

Riley Gomez: Yep will add README snippet in same PR.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. If anyone runs into repo permission or CI flak, ping me directly. Will re-check in once PR is up. :eyes:

Jin Park: I'll push a temporary pin patch in a separate PR ready to merge if CI needs it.

Maya Chen: last_message: Riley opened PR 3776015600 with adapter + test. Moving to followups channel after merge. :party-parrot:
